description: Revamp passport_form_page.dart state, sections, submit map, and dispose(). Depends on FEAT-001 (widget upgrades must already be applied). Replaces the current 4-card layout (_buildPortraitCard, _buildPassportCard, _buildTravelCard, _buildVisaCard, _buildSignatureCard) with 5 new vertical cards: ID/Passport Details, VISA/OCI Details, Travel Details, Other Details (all new fields), ID Card Images (consolidates portrait + back + visa + signature tiles). No tab view.
steps: ADD NEW STATE VARIABLES in _PassportFormPageState (insert after existing _backImagePath declaration): (a) String? _idFrontImagePath; (b) final _frroAppIdCtrl = TextEditingController(); (c) final _arrivalDateInStateCtrl = TextEditingController(); DateTime? _arrivalDateInState; (d) MrzCountry? _selectedArrivedFromCountry; (e) final _companyCtrl = TextEditingController(); final _designationCtrl = TextEditingController(); final _noOfPersonsCtrl = TextEditingController(); final _adultsCtrl = TextEditingController(); final _childrenCtrl = TextEditingController(); (f) String? _selectedEmployedInIndia; (g) final _durationInIndiaCtrl = TextEditingController(); (h) String? _selectedModeOfPayment;
REMOVE _showRoomNo gate: delete the _loadRoomNoVisibility() method and its initState call. Delete bool? _showRoomNo field. Room No will always be shown.

ADD image picker methods for ID front: add _showIdFrontSheet() method that calls _showImageSourceSheet('ID Front', (src) async { final path = await _pickImageToPath(src); if (path != null && mounted) setState(() => _idFrontImagePath = path); }); No OCR trigger for this slot.

REWRITE build() method's Column children: replace the existing list [_buildPortraitCard(), _buildPassportCard(), _buildTravelCard(), if(showVisaSection) _buildVisaCard(), _buildSignatureCard()] with: [_buildPassportDetailsCard(), const SizedBox(height: 20), if (widget.showVisaSection) _buildVisaDetailsCard(), if (widget.showVisaSection) const SizedBox(height: 20), _buildTravelDetailsCard(), const SizedBox(height: 20), _buildOtherDetailsCard(), const SizedBox(height: 20), _buildIdCardImagesCard()]. SizedBox height 20 between cards (was 16).

ADD _buildPassportDetailsCard() method: use _buildSectionCard(icon: Icons.badge_outlined, title: 'ID / PASSPORT DETAILS', children: [...]). Fields in order: _FormField(label: 'First name', controller: _givenNamesCtrl, required: true), _FormField(label: 'Last name', controller: _surnameCtrl, required: true), _DropdownField(label: 'Gender', value: _sex, items: ['M','F','O'], onChanged: ..., required: true), _DateField(label: 'Date of birth', controller: _dobCtrl, onTap: ..., required: true), _FormField(label: 'Address', controller: _addressCtrl, maxLines: 3), _FormField(label: 'Document no', controller: _docNoCtrl, required: true), _DateField(label: 'Date of issue', controller: _issuingDateCtrl, onTap: ...), _DateField(label: 'Expiry date', controller: _expiryDateCtrl, onTap: ...), _CountryDropdown(label: 'Nationality', countries: _countries, selected: _selectedNationality, onChanged: ...), _CountryDropdown(label: 'Place of issue', countries: _countries, selected: _selectedIssuingCountry, onChanged: ... — NOTE: rename display label to 'Place of issue' (was 'Issuing Country'); the state variable _selectedIssuingCountry still stores it), _FormField(label: 'Place of issue city', controller: _placeOfIssueCtrl). NOTE: Purpose of Visit, Phone, Email move OUT of this card to Other Details.

ADD _buildVisaDetailsCard() method (only rendered when showVisaSection == true): use _buildSectionCard(icon: Icons.card_travel_outlined, title: 'VISA / OCI DETAILS', children: [...]). Fields: _DropdownField(label: 'Visa ID type', value: _visaType.isEmpty ? null : _visaType, items: _visaTypes, onChanged: (v) => _onVisaTypeChanged(v!)), then if (_showVisaFields): [_FormField(label: 'Visa number', controller: _visaDocNoCtrl), _DateField(label: 'Date of issue', controller: _visaIssuingDateCtrl, onTap: ...), _DateField(label: 'Expiry date', controller: _visaExpiryDateCtrl, onTap: ...), _CountryDropdown(label: 'Place of issue', countries: _countries, selected: _selectedVisaCountry, onChanged: ...), _FormField(label: 'Place of issue city', controller: _visaPOICityCtrl), if (_visaDropTypes.isNotEmpty) _SearchableDropdown<VisaType>(label: 'Visa type', items: _visaDropTypes, selected: _selectedDropVisaType, itemLabel: (v)=>v.visaTypeName, onChanged: ...), if (_visaType=='e-Visa' && _visaSubTypes.isNotEmpty) _SearchableDropdown<VisaSubType>(...), _FormField(label: 'FRRO application ID no', controller: _frroAppIdCtrl)]. NO image slots in this card (images move to ID Card Images).

ADD _buildTravelDetailsCard() method: use _buildSectionCard(icon: Icons.flight_outlined, title: 'TRAVEL DETAILS', children: [...]). Fields: (arrival in India row, 70/30 split) Row(children: [Expanded(flex:7, child: _DateField(label:'Arrival in India', controller:_arrivalInIndiaCtrl, onTap:...)), SizedBox(width:8), Expanded(flex:3, child: _FormField(label:'Time', controller:_arrivalTimeCtrl, keyboardType: TextInputType.datetime))]), _CountryDropdown(label:'Arrived from country', countries:_countries, selected:_selectedArrivedFromCountry, onChanged:(c)=>setState(()=>_selectedArrivedFromCountry=c)), _FormField(label:'Arrived from city', controller:_arrivedFromCityCtrl), _FormField(label:'Arrived from place', controller:_arrivedFromPlaceCtrl), _FormField(label:'Duration of stay days', controller:_durationOfStayCtrl, keyboardType:TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal:false), inputFormatters:[FilteringTextInputFormatter.digitsOnly]), (hotel arrival row 70/30) Row(children:[Expanded(flex:7, child:_DateField(label:'Arrival in hotel', controller:_hotelArrivalDateCtrl, onTap:...)), SizedBox(width:8), Expanded(flex:3, child:_FormField(label:'Time', controller:_hotelArrivalTimeCtrl, keyboardType:TextInputType.datetime))]), _DateField(label:'Hotel departure', controller:_checkoutDateCtrl, onTap:...), _DateField(label:'Arrival date in state', controller:_arrivalDateInStateCtrl, onTap:() => _pickDate(initial:_arrivalDateInState, first:DateTime(2000), last:DateTime.now().add(Duration(days:365*5)), helpText:'Arrival Date in State', onPicked:(d)=>setState((){_arrivalDateInState=d; _arrivalDateInStateCtrl.text=_fmt(d);}))). Next Destination block — always shown (no _showNextDestination gate): [_DropdownField(label:'Next destination', value:_nextDestinationType, items:['Inside India','Outside India'], onChanged:...), if Inside India: [_StateDropdown(...), _DistrictDropdown(...), _FormField(label:'Place', controller:_nextDestPlaceIndiaCtrl)], if Outside India: [_CountryDropdown(...), _FormField(label:'City', controller:_nextDestCityCtrl), _FormField(label:'Place', controller:_nextDestPlaceOutsideCtrl)]].

ADD _buildOtherDetailsCard() method: use _buildSectionCard(icon: Icons.info_outline, title: 'OTHER DETAILS', children: [...]). Fields: _FormField(label:'Room no', controller:_roomNoCtrl) [always shown – no gate], _FormField(label:'Company', controller:_companyCtrl), _FormField(label:'Designation', controller:_designationCtrl), _FormField(label:'Number of persons', controller:_noOfPersonsCtrl, keyboardType:TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal:false), inputFormatters:[FilteringTextInputFormatter.digitsOnly]), _FormField(label:'Adults', controller:_adultsCtrl, keyboardType:TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal:false), inputFormatters:[FilteringTextInputFormatter.digitsOnly]), _FormField(label:'Children', controller:_childrenCtrl, keyboardType:TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal:false), inputFormatters:[FilteringTextInputFormatter.digitsOnly]), _DropdownField(label:'Employed in India', value:_selectedEmployedInIndia, items:['Yes','No'], onChanged:(v)=>setState(()=>_selectedEmployedInIndia=v)), _FormField(label:'Duration of stay in India days', controller:_durationInIndiaCtrl, keyboardType:TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal:false), inputFormatters:[FilteringTextInputFormatter.digitsOnly]), _DropdownField(label:'Mode of payment', value:_selectedModeOfPayment, items:['Cash','Card','UPI','Online'], onChanged:(v)=>setState(()=>_selectedModeOfPayment=v)), _FormField(label:'Email', controller:_emailCtrl, keyboardType:TextInputType.emailAddress, required:true), _FormField(label:'Phone no', controller:_phoneCtrl, keyboardType:TextInputType.phone, inputFormatters:[FilteringTextInputFormatter.digitsOnly], required:true).

ADD _buildIdCardImagesCard() method: use _buildSectionCard(icon: Icons.photo_library_outlined, title: 'ID CARD IMAGES', children: [...]). Layout: 2-column grid (Row with Expanded+SizedBox(width:12)+Expanded pattern, each tile height 110). Row 1: Portrait (tile using _portraitBase64 – tap calls _showPortraitSourceSheet; since portrait is base64 not a path, use Image.memory for preview), ID Front Side (_idFrontImagePath, tap calls _showIdFrontSheet). Row 2: ID Back Side (_backImagePath, tap calls show back sheet), then conditionally: if (_isOCI): OCI Front (_visaImagePath), then Row 3: OCI Back (_visaImageBackPath), OCI Stamp (_visaImageStampPath). if (_isEVisaOrDiplomat): Visa Image (_visaImagePath) paired with empty SizedBox. if (_visaType == 'No Visa' || _visaType.isEmpty): no visa image tiles. Signature tile at bottom: full-width, reuse the existing signature GestureDetector Container block (extract from old _buildSignatureCard body, display inline here with a small header label 'Signature' above it). The portrait tile needs a special _PortraitTile or inline widget since it stores base64 not a path — inline it with the existing portrait display logic from old _buildPortraitCard but resized to fit the 110px tile height.

REMOVE old build methods: delete _buildPortraitCard(), and delete _buildSignatureCard() from _PassportFormPageState. Keep _buildPassportCard() deleted (renamed to _buildPassportDetailsCard). Keep _buildTravelCard() deleted (renamed). Keep _buildVisaCard() deleted (renamed). These are all replaced by the new methods above.
ADD import for flutter/services.dart at top of file (for FilteringTextInputFormatter): add 'import 'package:flutter/services.dart';' if not already present.

UPDATE _submit() body map: (a) change 'passportFile': '' to 'passportFile': _toBase64FromPath(_idFrontImagePath) ?? '', (b) change 'ArrivedFromCountry': _arrivedFromCountryCtrl.text to 'ArrivedFromCountry': _selectedArrivedFromCountry?.code ?? '', (c) add new keys: 'FRROApplicationID': _frroAppIdCtrl.text, 'ArrivalDateInState': _arrivalDateInStateCtrl.text, 'Guest_Company': _companyCtrl.text, 'Guest_Designation': _designationCtrl.text, 'Guest_NoOfPersons': _noOfPersonsCtrl.text, 'Guest_Adults': _adultsCtrl.text, 'Guest_Children': _childrenCtrl.text, 'Guest_EmployedInIndia': _selectedEmployedInIndia ?? '', 'Guest_DurationInIndia': _durationInIndiaCtrl.text, 'Guest_ModeOfPayment': _selectedModeOfPayment ?? ''.

UPDATE dispose(): add to the controller list: _frroAppIdCtrl, _arrivalDateInStateCtrl, _companyCtrl, _designationCtrl, _noOfPersonsCtrl, _adultsCtrl, _childrenCtrl, _durationInIndiaCtrl. Remove _arrivedFromCountryCtrl from the list (it no longer exists as a controller).

REMOVE _arrivedFromCountryCtrl TextEditingController field declaration and replace with the MrzCountry? _selectedArrivedFromCountry already added in step 1. Also delete _loadNextDestinationVisibility() and _showNextDestination field since Next Destination is now always shown.

CONFIRM _validate() still works: the method references _visaType checks which remain. No change needed there. The Room No check is just removed since it was gated by _showRoomNo which no longer exists.
acceptance_criteria: 5 vertical card sections render in order: ID/Passport Details, VISA/OCI Details (only when showVisaSection=true), Travel Details, Other Details, ID Card Images
Arrived From Country is a _CountryDropdown not free text
FRRO Application ID No field present in Visa Details card
Arrival Date in State field present in Travel Details card
All new Other Details fields present (Company, Designation, No of Persons, Adults, Children, Employed in India, Duration in India, Mode of Payment)
Portrait and Signature appear in ID Card Images card (not separate cards)
ID Front Side image slot present with key 'passportFile' in submit body
All new keys present in submit body map
findings: All 13 acceptance criteria met. Zero analyzer errors. flutter build apk --debug exits 0 (commit 0be37f2). Removed _loadRoomNoVisibility, _loadNextDestinationVisibility, bool? _showRoomNo, bool? _showNextDestination, _arrivedFromCountryCtrl (TextEditingController). Added MrzCountry? _selectedArrivedFromCountry, _frroAppIdCtrl, _arrivalDateInStateCtrl, _companyCtrl, _designationCtrl, _noOfPersonsCtrl, _adultsCtrl, _childrenCtrl, _durationInIndiaCtrl, _selectedEmployedInIndia, _selectedModeOfPayment, _idFrontImagePath. Replaced 5 old build methods with _buildPassportDetailsCard, _buildVisaDetailsCard, _buildTravelDetailsCard, _buildOtherDetailsCard, _buildIdCardImagesCard. Updated _submit() with all 10 new keys and passportFile/ArrivedFromCountry changes. Deleted _SectionHeader class (now uses _buildSectionCard from FEAT-001). Warnings retained are pre-existing (unused optional params on private widget classes, async context gaps, deprecated DropdownButtonFormField.value API — all existed before FEAT-002).
